Effective October 13, 2026

Privacy,
by design.

Stickyy is designed to keep your thoughts on your Mac.

Data collection

Stickyy does not collect, transmit, sell, or share personal data. It contains no advertising, analytics, tracking, user accounts, or cloud service.

Local data

Scratchpads and their metadata are stored locally in Stickyy’s macOS app container. Clipboard Pills are temporary and remain in memory only while the app is running. Turning Clipboard History off clears them.

Images and files you explicitly paste are stored inside the local app container. When you use the macOS share menu, the system service you select receives the scratchpad text under that service’s own privacy terms.

Permissions and network access

Stickyy uses the macOS App Sandbox and does not require network access for its core functionality. It does not request microphone, camera, contacts, calendar, location, or accessibility access.

Changes and contact

Material changes will be published here with a new effective date.
